# Jingyue Glass (Wuhan Jingyueda Household Products Co., Ltd.)
> High-End OEM/ODM Glassware Manufacturer & Exporter in Wuhan, Hubei, China.

Jingyue Glass specializes in custom glassware manufacturing for B2B importers, distributors, restaurant groups, corporate gifting companies, and e-commerce brand owners worldwide.

## Core Manufacturing & Product Lines
- **Wine Glasses**: High-end hand-blown seamless pulled stemware (300-500 pcs MOQ) and machine-blown restaurant stemware (1,000+ pcs MOQ).
- **Whiskey Glasses & Decanters**: Heavy-base Old Fashioned rocks glasses, rotating glasses, diamond faceted tumblers, and lead-free crystal decanter gift sets (200 sets MOQ).
- **Beer Glasses & Mugs**: Commercial pint glasses (570ml), wheat beer glasses, pilsner glasses, and heavy handled beer steins with laser nucleated base options.
- **Double-Wall Glass Mugs**: Heat-resistant borosilicate coffee and tea mugs (ΔT ≥ 120°C) with hydrophobic silicone safety pressure vents.
- **Cocktail & Mixology Sets**: Smoked cocktail kits (XZ-SMK01 to XZ-SMK08), martini glasses, ribbed coupes, and barware accessories in drop-tested wooden boxes.
- **Commercial Bar & Lounge Supply**: Turnkey hospitality barware opening packages, per-seat par level planning, and 1,000+ cycle industrial dishwasher resistance.
- **Amazon FBA & E-commerce Private Label**: 1.2M drop-tested packaging with EVA/EPE foam inserts, top/bottom clamp protective packaging, and FNSKU labeling.

## Factory Verification & Compliance Evidence
- **TÜV Rheinland Physical Audit**: Report No. 496575858_P+T (Valid 2026-09-17 to 2027-09-16) — 10,000 m² manufacturing facility, ISO 9001 quality management, physical audit verified.
- **California Proposition 65**: Lab Tested (Report No. SZ2025091217-4E) — Lead & Cadmium leachability < 0.100 ppm.
- **FDA Food Contact Compliance**: Lab Tested (Report No. PTC24100807301C-EN01/02) — Complies with FDA CPG Sec. 545.400 / 545.450 (4% acetic acid leach).
- **German LFGB & EU 1935/2004**: Lab Tested (Report No. PTC23022404104C) — Heavy metal migration passed for European food contact.
- **Packaging EPR Compliance**: French EPR Registration No. FR310935_01FTBN, EU PPWR recyclability compliant.
- **Drop Test Standard**: ISTA-1A 1.2-meter multi-angle drop tested gift packaging.

## Customization Capabilities & Logistics
- **Decoration Methods**: High-fire lead-free decals (580°C–600°C, 1000+ dishwasher cycles), laser engraving, 24K gold rim, frosted acid etching, electroplating, and custom spray color.
- **MOQ Tiers**: Standard stock samples (1-5 pcs), custom logo trial orders (48-96 pcs), production runs (200-500 pcs), OEM custom molds (1,000-3,000 pcs).
- **Customs & Logistics Support**: US Section 301 tariff mitigation advice, HS Chapter 7013 classification (7013.28, 7013.37, 7013.99), DDP sea/air freight to warehouse and Amazon fulfillment centers (ONT8, FTW1, CLT2).
